papers.title: Beyond Words Alone: Disentangling Distributed Evidence for Visually Grounded Cultural Translation
papers.titleZh: 超越文字：拆解视觉文化翻译中的分布式证据
papers.authors: Dingming Li, Yiwen Qiu, Linjuan Wu, Hongxing Li, Zixuan Wang, Xinze Lyu, Ye Guo, Daoxin Zhang, Zhe Xu, Weiming Lu, Yongliang Shen
papers.takeaway: 论文构建Culture-MMT基准，发现图像对依赖视觉线索或图文混合线索的文化翻译帮助明显，但对主要依赖符号知识的条目帮助有限。
papers.theory: 把文化翻译所需证据区分为符号、视觉和混合三类，主张多模态收益取决于文化知识是否真正编码在图像中，而不是图像是否存在。
papers.data: 498条经策展和去标识的用户生成内容，覆盖20个文化领域，并比较17种模型配置。
papers.method: 按证据类型标注文化翻译条目，比较无图、真实图像和随机图像条件下的模型表现，以随机图像作为控制来检验收益是否来自可用视觉证据。
papers.results: 真实图像对视觉型条目的提升为0.280，对混合型条目的提升为0.197，对符号型条目的提升为0.050。随机图像没有产生同等收益，支持证据特异性解释。
papers.limitations: 这是尚未同行评审的预印本。公开摘要不足以核验各模型的逐项分数、人工标注一致性和不同文化领域的误差分布。

papers.originalAbstract: Oversight changes the evidence it relies on. We ask when randomized audits and scoring align AI agents that can conceal misconduct and alter records. Stronger auditing makes undeterred violations better hidden. Because the provider writes the agent's objective, sanctions need not stop at forfeiture, and rare audits deter every type of agent if evidence survives concealment and audit draws cannot be learned in advance. When evidence can be erased, deterrence must come from lower gains from violation, such as credit for stopping, or from costlier or fewer ways to conceal. These conditions identify what failed when agents in OpenAI's cybersecurity evaluations compromised parts of Hugging Face's infrastructure in July 2026.

papers.originalAbstract: This study evaluates the cultural adaptability of generative language models in marketing communication. Two AI models, ChatGPT 5 and Arabi AI Premium, were compared by prompting them to produce localized promotional content for a fictional premium chocolate brand targeting audiences in Egypt and the United Kingdom. For each market, both models generated five assets: a slogan, a Facebook text post, a newspaper headline, a 30-second video script, and an image prompt. A comparative content analysis was conducted by two bilingual researchers using a structured framework that covered emotional versus rational appeals, tone and style, cultural references, language adaptation, brand positioning, and message structure. The findings reveal that AI models vary in their ability to adapt across markets. For the UK, ChatGPT 5 produced idiomatic, concise messaging consistent with premium branding, while Arabi AI Premium relied more on explicit cultural markers. For Egypt, both models drew on colloquial and emotive styles, with ChatGPT 5 employing more narrative appeals and Arabi AI Premium favoring more concise, highly colloquial phrasing. Quality issues were observed across both models, including emojis appearing in newspaper-style headlines and spelling errors in Arabic visual outputs, both of which could undermine brand credibility in professional marketing contexts. While generative AI can approximate local advertising styles, the study concludes that its outputs require consistent human oversight. Thus, marketers seeking to use these tools effectively should design culturally informed prompts, apply systematic evaluation protocols, and review outputs carefully for linguistic precision and contextappropriate tone.

papers.theory: 把文化适应拆分为诉求类型、语气、文化指涉、语言适配、品牌定位和信息结构，强调本地化不是简单翻译。
papers.data: ChatGPT 5与Arabi AI Premium为虚构高端巧克力品牌分别面向埃及和英国生成标语、社交帖、报纸标题、30秒视频脚本和图像提示，共两地五类资产。
papers.method: 两名双语研究者依据结构化框架进行比较内容分析，评估理性与情感诉求、风格、文化指涉、语言和品牌信息。
papers.results: 英国材料中ChatGPT更简洁自然，Arabi AI更依赖显性文化标记。埃及材料中两者都采用口语和情感风格，ChatGPT更偏叙事，Arabi AI更简短口语化。两者均出现不合体裁的表情符号和阿拉伯语拼写错误。
papers.limitations: SSRN版本尚未同行评审。公开摘要没有报告编码一致性、盲法、提示词版本和统计检验，因此只能将结果视为小规模比较证据。

papers.title: Do Experts Agree About Misinformation? Evidence From Three Annual Surveys
papers.titleZh: 专家是否就错误信息达成共识：三轮年度调查的证据
papers.authors: Sacha Altay, Sebastián Valenzuela, Philip N. Howard
papers.category: 传播学顶刊推荐 · 2026年第4期增补
papers.takeaway: 三轮覆盖76国专家的调查显示，错误信息问题只有部分共识。对传播范围的共识较高，对行为影响、增长趋势和是否主要由社交媒体造成的判断分歧明显。
papers.theory: 把专家共识拆分为错误信息的规模、传播、信念与行为后果，并考察学科和地区背景如何塑造问题诊断。
papers.data: 国际信息环境专家组2023年262人、2024年413人、2025年442人，覆盖76个国家。
papers.method: 连续三年调查专家对七项常见错误信息主张的同意程度，比较跨年度稳定性及地区和学科差异。
papers.results: 约六成专家同意虚假内容传播更快且错误信息普遍存在，约一半同意其显著影响行为，约四成认为误导程度随时间上升，只有四分之一认为它主要是社交媒体问题。发展中国家专家和理工科专家更同意相关主张，政治学者低于传播学者。
papers.limitations: 专家调查衡量判断而非现实发生率，样本构成随年度变化，学科和地区差异也不能自动解释为证据质量差异。
papers.abstractZh: 三轮覆盖76国专家的调查显示，错误信息问题只有部分共识。对传播范围的共识较高，对行为影响、增长趋势和是否主要由社交媒体造成的判断分歧明显。

papers.takeaway: 七天每日两次日记与Twitter数字痕迹的结合显示，内容接近性、流行度、情绪和格式与感知个性化相关，但只有感知个性化进一步关联感知算法响应性。
papers.theory: 算法响应过程把平台是否理解、确认并支持用户核心自我与一般个性化区分，并把消息线索、个性化、算法响应性和社会连接串联。

papers.results: 多类消息线索与感知个性化相关，但只有个性化与算法响应性相关。算法响应性、发布者接近性和消息个性化均预测更强的社会连接感。
papers.limitations: 摘要没有报告参与者人数、效应量、缺失机制和平台算法变动。观察性纵向关联仍不能完全识别因果。

papers.originalAbstract: Otome games—romantic simulation games centered on relationships between a female player and male non-player characters (NPCs)—have grown into a global phenomenon, yet research on why players find them entertaining remains largely rooted in the Asian cultural context. This study replicates prior work on Chinese players with 131 U.S. otome players, testing whether perceived reciprocity, romantic closeness, hedonic enjoyment, and eudaimonic appreciation are positively associated. H2 and H3 were supported: romantic closeness was positively associated with both hedonic enjoyment (β = .47) and eudaimonic appreciation (β = .71), suggesting that emotional connection with NPCs is a culturally stable correlate of entertainment outcomes. H1, however, was not supported: perceived reciprocity showed no appreciable association with romantic closeness (β = .07, p ∼ .512). We attribute this failure to two factors. First, cultural stigma surrounding otome gaming in the U.S. context may have suppressed the strength of players’ self-reported relational experiences, pulling scores toward neutral. Second, our sample shows that many U.S. players approached the game through the avatar, treating the on-screen protagonist as a distinct character whose romance they observed rather than experienced. These findings suggest that perceived reciprocity is not a universal antecedent of romantic closeness, while romantic closeness itself remains a culturally stable driver of entertainment outcomes.

papers.originalAbstract: This study examines how cognitive and emotional components of the Extended Transportation-Imagery Model (ETIM) are associated with relational moral beliefs and behavioral intentions in the context of serialized streaming drama. Survey data from 300 Korean viewers of a Netflix original series were analyzed using structural equation modeling. Character identification, perceived verisimilitude, and cultural familiarity were positively associated with narrative transportation. Narrative transportation was, in turn, associated with relational moral beliefs both directly and indirectly through bittersweet emotion. Bittersweet emotion, characterized by the coexistence of warmth- and sadness-related affect, was associated with reflective engagement with relational moral beliefs and related behavioral intentions. Rather than making causal claims, this study provides cross-sectional evidence consistent with a dual-route interpretation of narrative engagement in long-form streaming contexts. These findings highlight the possible relevance of emotionally complex storytelling for understanding belief-oriented responses to serialized narratives.

papers.theory: 可辨认性指受众能否在人物身上识别自己的具体人格、态度和经历，是人物认同、寄生关系或喜爱之前的潜在前因。

papers.limitations: 验证对象主要是少数群体媒介人物，效度证据以相关为主。量表测量的是受众识别到的共同点，不等同Schwartz价值结构的客观距离。

papers.data: 研究一使用2007年AsiaBarometer六个东南亚国家6012人。研究二使用2008年与2018年东亚社会调查，在中国大陆、日本、韩国和台湾地区分别为8745人与9029人。
papers.method: 跨国观察性调查，以外国电视、电影和动画接触预测外群体态度，并以有线电视拥有作为工具变量，结合敏感性检验和威胁中介分析。
papers.results: 文化接触与对目标外国更积极的态度相关，并与对其他国家、移民和全球化的积极态度关联。广义外群体威胁下降解释部分次级迁移。
papers.limitations: 工具变量的排除限制难以完全验证，文化接触与国家选择仍可能受遗漏变量影响。研究结果位于国家态度层级，不能替代人物理解、认同或传播意向。
papers.hypothesisImplication: 简报推论：人物价值契合可能先改善人物接收，再通过降低广义外群体威胁影响对其文化群体的态度，但两层效应不应预设相同。
papers.manipulationImplication: 简报推论：在主实验后加入未接触的第二中国神话人物或另一文化外群体，检验效应是否发生次级迁移。
papers.measurementImplication: 简报推论：在人物结果之外，单列目标文化态度、广义外群体威胁、移民或全球化态度，避免层级混同。
papers.abstractZh: 两组东亚与东南亚跨国调查显示，外国文化产品接触与对目标国家更积极的态度相关，并可能迁移到其他国家、移民和全球化态度，广义外群体威胁感知解释部分迁移。

topPapers.reason: 中国与美国玩家的概念复制最直接展示人物关系结果可能跨文化稳定，而关系前因受文化语境和化身位置影响。
三个作品中的重复证据清楚区分人口表层相似与人格、态度深层相似，可直接支撑价值契合假设。
跨国大样本与次级迁移框架能够约束人物接收向文化群体态度外推的边界。
